title: unified rollouts: telemetry-driven quarantine + improved canary/AB/shadow autorollback workflow
author: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: Rollouts that use canary/AB/shadow modes lacked a robust, telemetry-driven quarantine step and the autorollback engine did not surface enough signals for safe automatic rollbacks. This made some progressive deployments either too slow (manual intervention required) or unsafe (spurious rollbacks on transient signals).

Goal: Add a configurable quarantine stage that gates promotion using composite telemetry (latency, error-rate, output-quality delta), surface detailed telemetry hooks to the autorollback engine, and include safety guards to prevent oscillation and noisy rollbacks. Maintain backward compatibility with current rollout YAML and defaults.

Changes in this PR: implemented a telemetry-driven quarantine stage that runs immediately after a canary/shadow probe window; integrated quarantine verdicts into the existing autorollback engine; added composite metric matching and quorum logic; improved tracing/metrics emitted during rollout, and added e2e tests and canary AB integration tests.

Key design notes: quarantine is an optional stage inserted between probe and promote steps; it evaluates a composite of configured metrics with quorum rules (majority-of-metrics or weighted-sum threshold) and supports manual override. Autorollback now consumes quarantine signals and respects stability windows and cooldowns (configurable). To avoid oscillation we add a rolling backoff: subsequent rollbacks increase cooldown and require stronger metric deviations.

Migration/compatibility: rollout specs without a quarantine section keep previous behavior. New fields are additive and default to safe values (quarantine disabled, quorum=majority, cooldown=2m).

Checklist: [x] telemetry hooks (metrics + tracing) added, [x] quarantine evaluation logic, [x] autorollback integration, [x] unit tests for metric matching and quorum, [x] e2e stability tests, [x] docs updated with example rollout YAML, [x] load tests for tokenized traffic in perf lab.

How to review: start with rollout controller changes (controllers/rollout_controller.go), quarantine evaluator (pkg/rollouts/quarantine.go), and autorollback adapter (pkg/autorollback/quarantine_adapter.go). e2e tests are in tests/e2e/rollouts/quarantine. Observability additions are in telemetry/metrics/rollout_metrics.go and tracing/rollout_spans.md.

Risks/notes: composite weighting defaults are conservative but operators should tune thresholds for high-variance workloads. We added a feature flag (feature.rollouts.quarantine_v1) to allow staged enablement in Dedicated/Private customers.

Related: ENG-1423 (quarantine design), ENG-1424 (autorollback signal surface), SUP-5123 (customer case where rapid canary oscillation caused production regressions).
commits: feat(rollouts): add quarantine stage and evaluator
feat(autorollback): consume quarantine verdicts and add cooldown/backoff
chore(telemetry): emit rollout_quarantine_* metrics and tracing spans
test(e2e): add quarantine e2e and stability tests
fix(rollouts): ensure canary weight resets on manual rollback
doc: rollout YAML examples and upgrade notes
review_comments: Samir Patel: Overall this looks good. Please add a unit test that covers weighted quorum where a high-latency metric is discounted. Also add a safety guard for missing metrics so we don't default to FAIL when the backend temporarily returns NaN.
Priya Shah (author): Added tests for missing metrics and an explicit NaN-handling path. Weighted quorum unit test added in pkg/rollouts/quarantine_test.go. PTAL.
Linnea Gomez: Question on cooldown/backoff: can we make the initial cooldown configurable per-rollout? Also add a small note to the docs about expected default (2m).
Priya Shah (author): Done — cooldown is now configurable in the rollout spec with a cluster default. Docs updated.
Diego Ramirez: e2e failure on first run: observed a flaky integration where shadow traffic probe sometimes had delayed metrics ingestion. Is there a guard?

Priya Shah (author): I added a buffering step in telemetry/metrics to avoid transient ingestion gaps and retried the e2e; passing now. We also added an e2e stability guard that reruns if ingestion lag > 5s.
Samir Patel: Approving — left minor doc nit. Verified CI and smoke runs.
Linnea Gomez: Approved after minor doc changes.
release_notes: Added an optional quarantine stage for rollouts that evaluates composite telemetry (latency/error/quality) and integrates with the autorollback engine. New rollout YAML examples and observability metrics/tracing included. Defaults are conservative; enable via feature.rollouts.quarantine_v1.
e2e_results: e2e/quarantine: 3 scenarios run (canary-promotion, ab-compare, shadow-quarantine). First run had transient telemetry ingestion lag (fixed), final run shows stable pass across all scenarios. Avg success time (canary->promote) under quarantine: 48s (configurable).
notes: Feature flagged; ops must enable feature.rollouts.quarantine_v1 in Dedicated clusters to opt in. Recommend running perf/canary_quarantine_loadtest in staging for high-variance workloads before enabling in production.
